posts.title: CVE-2025-67736 FreePBX Authenticated SQL Injection leads to RCE
posts.description: Overview This will be fairly straight to the point since it’s another FreePBX vulnerability. It’s an authenticated SQLi, so not the end of the world as you’d need admin access, but it was a cool way to access a technique watchTowr blogged about to add a cron job to the freepbx database and get RCE.
